context_policy.rule: Every scheduler must begin from the complete repository state for its checked-out revision, load config/operator_directives.json as the latest explicit operator authority, then read the V7 live champion, scheduler registry and architecture manifest. Older PR text, comments or inferred policy never override config/operator_directives.json. Retired predecessor runtime surfaces and multi-version adapters must not be reintroduced.

grafana.rule: The canonical V7 dashboard follows the V7 PAPER runtime only.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
